name: Crazy House
summary: Climb the concrete rooms and narrow walkways at Biệt thự Hằng Nga, the house Dang Viet Nga designed at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang. Hang Nga Ltd prints 08:30 to 19:00. Visitors from 1.4 m pay 80,000 VND. Leave the large bag behind. The passages are tight.

notice.title: Passages are tight
notice.body: Hang Nga Ltd describes a walk through the rooms. A large bag makes the narrow passages harder. The visit is 45 to 60 minutes.

body: Crazy House is Biệt thự Hằng Nga, at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang. Dang Viet Nga designed the concrete rooms and the bridges between them. You walk through, rather than look from the street. The exterior is the frame to know before you go in.

Hang Nga Ltd prints 08:30 to 19:00. Plan 45 to 60 minutes. Visitors from 1.4 m pay 80,000 VND, a child from 1.2 m to 1.4 m pays 30,000 VND, and under 1.2 m is free. Go near opening if you want the rooms before the tour groups. Leave the large bag.

figures.caption: A walkway inside Crazy House
figures.alt: An interior passage at Crazy House in Da Lat

gettingThere: The house is at 03 Huynh Thuc Khang, on the west side of town. Take a taxi or Grab from Xuan Huong Lake. The minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi or Grab to 03 Huynh Thuc Khang. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: Hang Nga Ltd: visitors from 1.4 m pay 80,000 VND. A child from 1.2 m to 1.4 m pays 30,000 VND. Under 1.2 m is free. Hours are 08:30 to 19:00.
